title: Vibe Trading launches open-source AI hedge fund with live #VibeTrading #AIhedgefund
description: Hong Kong University released Vibe Trading, an open-source AI hedge fund that operates for free on your laptop. It uses multiple AI agents to handle research, strategy building, backtesting, and risk review, providing a full trading desk experience directly in your terminal. Vibe Trading integrates live data from 18 different markets, including stocks, crypto, and forex, and conducts stress tests using Monte Carlo simulations before any real money is risked. Users can upload their broker history to identify costly trading habits and access over 400 pre-built quantitative strategies. With a growing community of 15,000 developers, Vibe Trading represents a significant innovation in democratizing advanced AI-driven trading tools and risk management, potentially reshaping retail and professional investment approaches. #VibeTrading #HongKongUniversity #AIHedgeFund #QuantTrading #AlgorithmicTrading #StockMarketAI #CryptoTrading #ForexAI #OpenSourceAI #FinancialTechnology #MonteCarloSimulation #TradingStrategy #RetailInvesting #AIInnovation #QuantitativeFinance
